column1: # The Racket builds scripts/install-racket.sh can install, one per platform, pinned
# by sha256 (st-2t1): the minimal distribution of the version racket-version names.
#   name    sha256    upstream URL(s), nearest first
# The script tries STELIS_DOWNLOAD_MIRROR/<sha256> first when that is set (a bucket
# a consumer owns: salishsea's is https://salishsea.io/downloads, its decision 084),
# then each URL here, and installs the first file whose bytes match. The checksum
# decides what is installed, never the host. download.racket-lang.org is last: it
# redirects to a mirror whose certificate Debian did not trust in October 2026
# (salishsea-io#727), so Utah's and Waterloo's copies go first.
# The same shape as salishsea's fly/downloads.tsv, so its mirror script can read this
# file at the Stelis commit it pins and keep its bucket holding the Racket that commit
# To move Racket: change racket-version, then each row here (the sha256 Racket
# publishes beside the installer, and the URLs), and let CI's install prove it.
